objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed information object (policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction) that goes through creation, editing, release, distribution, versioning and archiving lifecycle.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the document, incremented on each revision or change.

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released version of the document is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document remains valid, calculated from Valid From plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable time span (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable retention period (default 10 years) after invalidation before physical deletion.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Area of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, etc.).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Language in which the document content is maintained or translated.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by this document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document via properties.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or organizational areas for which the document is valid.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: A controlled sub-document linked to a main document, subject to its own versioning and released together with the main document.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: A supplementary sub-document linked to a main document that is not subject to the release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A formal proposal to amend an existing released document, managed in the document cockpit and tracked through implementation.

objs.name: request_for_validity_extension
objs.description: A system-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to check and extend validity.

objs.name: request_for_override
objs.description: A request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity, triggering a suspension workflow.

objs.name: request_for_reactivation
objs.description: A request to re-validate a previously invalidated (archived) document, triggering a reactivation workflow.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person who participates in document processes in one or more roles.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user such as Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, or Reader.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used for assigning read or acknowledgement authorizations to documents.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: A predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents.

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A system-supported process instance that orchestrates approval steps (Creator, Review, Release) with electronic signatures.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: A signature recorded by a workflow participant to confirm completion of a workflow step.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: A list of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: dashboard
objs.description: A role-specific view presenting documents and evaluations relevant to the logged-in user.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system in which documents can be made visible or hidden.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by selecting a document type and optionally a template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the integrated editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_properties
evts.description: Metadata and attributes of a document are entered or updated in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step approval process (Creator-Review-Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_as_creator
evts.description: The registered author signs the document in the first step of the release workflow.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: release_document
evts.description: A releaser approves and releases the document, making it available to addressed readers.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to authorized readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created when revisions or attachment changes occur.

evts.name: add_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment is added to a document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next version of the main document.

evts.name: add_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is added to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional information object is removed from a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: An author creates a change proposal for an existing released document without affecting its content or version.

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, which may trigger a new document version.

evts.name: create_request_for_validity_extension
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document's valid-until date.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally author/reviewer) confirms additional validity, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_request_for_override
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate and archive a document.

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: The releaser (and optionally reviewer) confirms invalidation, setting the document status to Out of Force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: create_request_for_reactivation
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate a previously invalidated document.

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the invalidated document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list receive an email notification about the new document version.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Upon release, users on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: The translated language version is checked and released with workflow support, making it visible to readers.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to users or user groups for a specific document.

evts.name: send_email_notification
evts.description: The system sends an email to inform users about workflow tasks, status changes, or pending actions.

o2o.description: An Attachment belongs to and is controlled by a main Document.
An Additional Info is supplementary to a main Document.
A Change Proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific Document.
A Request For Validity Extension is linked to the Document whose validity is being checked.
A Request For Override is created for a specific Document to be invalidated.
A Request For Reactivation references the archived Document to be reactivated.
One or more Document Templates can be defined for each document type and selected when creating a Document.
A Distribution List is maintained per Document to control notification and acknowledgement recipients.
User Groups are assigned to the Distribution List for email or acknowledgement distribution.
Users are assigned to User Groups for authorization and distribution purposes.
A Document can reference another Document via the References attribute or local extension in a client.
A Document can be made visible or hidden in specific Clients in a multi-client system.
Electronic Signatures are documented for each workflow participant per released version.
